# Decoy vault: a second pattern that opens a harmless vault

URL: https://getnoxium.app/features/decoy-vault
Last updated: 2026-11-16

Feature
## Decoy vault: a second pattern that opens a harmless vault
By Inertia Projects · Last updated 16 November 2026
Short answer
In Noxium, a second pattern opens a separate, harmless vault that looks like an ordinary Noxium. Nothing on the lock screen or in Settings shows that other vaults exist. The free plan includes 1 decoy vault; Pro adds as many as you like.
Sometimes the threat isn't a hacker. It's a person standing next to you saying "open it". A decoy vault gives you something to open. Noxium, the photo vault we make, builds decoys in from the start: each vault has its own pattern, its own encryption keys and its own contents. This page covers how Noxium's decoy works, how to set one up, and what it can't do. For decoys in general, across apps, read what is a decoy vault?
### How does Noxium's decoy vault work?
Every pattern you set opens exactly one vault. Your main pattern opens your real vault; a decoy pattern opens the decoy.
- One lock screen for all vaults. You draw on the same 5×5 plate of bolts. Noxium tries the pattern and opens whichever vault it belongs to.
- Separate keys. Each vault's key is made from its own pattern through Argon2id, and its files are sealed with AES-256-GCM. The decoy pattern can't open the main vault, and the main pattern can't open the decoy. See pattern lock and on-device encryption .
- No list of vaults. Noxium never shows how many vaults exist. A wrong pattern opens nothing and doesn't hint at what's there.
- It looks ordinary. The decoy is called "Noxium", like the real one. Its Settings look the same, and nothing in it says "decoy".
- Counts stay separate. Backup status only shows items from the vault that's open, so the decoy never gives away that a bigger vault exists.
### How do you set up a decoy vault?
Open your main vault, go to Settings › Vaults › Add a decoy vault , and draw a new pattern.
- Open your main vault and tap Settings .
- Under Vaults , tap Add a decoy vault .
- Draw the decoy pattern across at least 6 bolts. It has to be different from every pattern you already use. Noxium confirms: "Decoy vault ready. Draw its pattern on the lock screen to open it."
- Lock Noxium and draw the decoy pattern on the lock screen. The decoy opens, empty.
- Fill it with harmless things. Screenshots, receipts, food, a few notes. A believable decoy has some photos in it.
- Practise both patterns so that, under pressure, you draw the one you mean.
A decoy can have its own recovery phrase too: open the decoy and use Settings › Recovery phrase , as described on the recovery phrase page.
### When does a decoy vault help?
When someone knows you have Noxium and asks you to open it.
- A partner, parent or friend who saw the app and wants to look inside.
- Someone who takes your phone and demands that you unlock it.
- Showing photos to someone without opening your real vault in front of them.
If you need more than a decoy, Pro adds an emergency erase pattern : drawing it opens a harmless vault and erases the others.
### What doesn't a decoy vault protect?
A decoy only works if the other person believes it. It can't stop someone who knows more than you'd like.
- Someone who watches you draw your real pattern. They can draw it too. Draw with your hand covering the screen.
- Face ID. Face ID opens your main vault, never a decoy. If someone could hold your phone up to your face, leave Face ID off.
- Someone who knows decoys exist. Noxium's decoy feature is public, including on this page. A person who knows may ask for "the other pattern".
- Storage totals. Settings › General › iPhone Storage shows how much space Noxium uses in all. A decoy with 20 photos in an app using 8 GB invites questions.
- Photos still in your camera roll. The decoy protects what's inside Noxium. Delete the originals from Photos, then empty Recently Deleted .
- The law. Some countries require you to unlock devices for police or at a border. A decoy is not a way around a legal order, and this page isn't legal advice.
### Is it free or Pro?
The free plan includes 1 decoy vault. Pro removes the limit, so you can add as many decoys as you like.
The free plan also includes 150 photos, 10 videos, unlimited notes, and full iCloud backup and restore. Pro adds unlimited items, emergency erase, iPhone and iPad sync , custom icons, album patterns and shared vaults . See pricing .
Something harmless to open
A second pattern opens a separate, ordinary-looking vault. Nothing shows that the real one exists. Free plan included.
Download on the App Store
Available on the App Store for iPhone and iPad.
### Questions people ask
What is a decoy vault in a photo vault app?
A second, harmless vault that opens with a different code or pattern. You show it instead of your real vault when someone asks you to open the app.
Can someone tell that a Noxium vault is a decoy?
Not from inside Noxium. The decoy has the same name and the same Settings, and nothing lists other vaults. They could still guess from how much storage Noxium uses, or because they know decoys exist.
Is the decoy vault encrypted too?
Yes. Each vault has its own key, made from its own pattern, and every photo, video and note in it is encrypted with AES-256-GCM.
Can I use the same pattern for two vaults?
No. Noxium refuses a pattern that already opens another vault, so each pattern always opens exactly one.
Does Face ID open the decoy?
No. Face ID only ever opens the main vault. To open the decoy, draw its pattern.

# Emergency erase: a pattern that wipes your vaults

URL: https://getnoxium.app/features/emergency-erase
Last updated: 2026-11-16

Feature
## Emergency erase: a pattern that wipes your vaults
By Inertia Projects · Last updated 16 November 2026
Short answer
Emergency erase is a separate pattern you set in Noxium Pro. If someone forces you to open the app, draw it instead of your real pattern: Noxium opens a new, empty vault and quietly erases every other vault on the iPhone. You choose at setup whether your iCloud backups are kept. It can't be undone.
Most photo vaults call this a panic button or duress mode. In Noxium, the photo vault we make, it's a pattern, so using it looks exactly like opening the app. This page explains what it erases, how to set it up safely, and when not to use it. It's a last resort, and it's built to be one: there's no undo, no recycle bin and no confirmation screen.
### What happens when you draw the emergency erase pattern?
Noxium opens an empty vault that looks ordinary, and erases every other vault on the iPhone at the same moment.
- You draw it on the normal lock screen. It's a pattern on the same 5×5 plate, so nobody watching sees a special button or a warning.
- A new, empty vault opens. It looks like an ordinary Noxium, with nothing to say it was an erase pattern.
- Every other vault is erased. Your main vault and every decoy vault on the iPhone: their files, their records in Noxium's database, and the Face ID key for the main vault. Noxium's own tests check that no trace of the erased vaults is left in its files.
- Old patterns stop working. Afterwards, your main pattern opens nothing.
- iCloud follows your setup choice. By default your iCloud backups are kept; if you chose to, they're deleted too.
Because the vaults are encrypted, the files that were erased were also unreadable without your pattern. Erasing removes them altogether. See on-device encryption for how that works.
### How do you set up emergency erase?
Open your main vault, go to Settings › Vaults › Emergency erase pattern , choose what gets erased, and draw a new pattern.
- Open your main vault and tap Settings . Under Vaults , tap Emergency erase pattern . It needs Pro.
- Choose what gets erased:
- This iPhone only , marked recommended. Your iCloud backups stay, so you can restore later with your normal pattern.
- This iPhone and iCloud backups . Also deletes the other vaults' iCloud backups. Nothing can bring them back.
- Confirm that you understand the pattern permanently deletes your other vaults, then tap Draw emergency erase pattern .
- Draw a pattern across at least 6 bolts that you don't use for any other vault.
- Don't test it. Drawing it erases your vaults for real. Practise drawing the shape somewhere else, such as on paper.
Make sure your iCloud backup is up to date in Settings › iCloud backup if you chose "This iPhone only". That backup is how you get your photos back later.
### Can you get your photos back afterwards?
Only if you chose "This iPhone only" and your backup was up to date. Then your vaults are still in your iCloud, and your normal pattern restores them.
If you chose "This iPhone and iCloud backups", nothing can bring them back: not us, not Apple. That's the point of that option, and the reason Noxium shows a warning and asks you to confirm before you set it.
### What doesn't emergency erase protect?
It erases what's in Noxium on this iPhone. It can't reach anything else, and it can't change what someone already knows.
- Copies outside Noxium. Photos still in your camera roll, in Recently Deleted, in iCloud Photos, in a computer backup or in a chat app aren't touched.
- iCloud backups, by default. With "This iPhone only", encrypted backups stay in your iCloud. They're unreadable without your pattern, but they exist.
- An empty vault can look odd. Someone who expected to see photos may not believe an empty Noxium. A decoy vault filled with harmless photos is often the better first answer.
- Someone who knows the feature. Noxium's emergency erase is public, including on this page.
- Anything already copied. If someone copied files or photographed your screen before, erasing now doesn't undo that.
- The law. In many countries, deleting data after police or border officers ask for it can be a crime in itself. Emergency erase is for coercion by people with no right to your photos, not for defying a legal order. This page is general information, not legal advice.
### Is it free or Pro?
Emergency erase is part of Noxium Pro. The free plan includes 1 decoy vault, which helps in many of the same situations.
Pro also adds unlimited items, iPhone and iPad sync, custom icons, album patterns and shared vaults . See pricing .
A last resort you hope never to use
One pattern opens an empty vault and erases the rest. You choose whether your iCloud backups stay.
Download on the App Store
Available on the App Store for iPhone and iPad.
### Questions people ask
What is a panic erase in a photo vault?
A code or pattern that deletes the vault's contents instead of opening them. In Noxium it opens an empty vault and erases every other vault on the iPhone.
Does emergency erase delete my iCloud backup?
Only if you chose "This iPhone and iCloud backups" at setup. The recommended choice, "This iPhone only", keeps your backups so you can restore later.
Does Noxium show anything when the erase pattern is drawn?
No. It opens an ordinary-looking empty vault, with no message, countdown or confirmation.
Can I undo an emergency erase?
Not on the iPhone. If your iCloud backups were kept and up to date, your normal pattern restores them; if not, the vaults are gone for good.
Should I use it at a border?
Be careful. In many countries deleting data after officers ask for it can be an offence. Read the rules for where you're going before you travel, and consider leaving sensitive photos off the phone instead.

# Custom app icons: make your photo vault look ordinary

URL: https://getnoxium.app/features/custom-app-icons
Last updated: 2026-11-16

Feature
## Custom app icons: make your photo vault look ordinary
By Inertia Projects · Last updated 16 November 2026
Short answer
With Noxium Pro, you can swap the app's icon for a Calculator, Notes or Weather lookalike in Settings › App settings › Change app icon . Every icon still opens Noxium's lock screen. The name under the icon stays "Noxium"; for any name and picture, make a Home Screen shortcut with the "Open Noxium" action.
A photo vault's icon tells everyone what it is. A plain one doesn't. Noxium, the photo vault we make, offers three plain-looking icons, plus a Shortcuts action for a fully custom one. This page shows how to change the icon, what else Noxium hides on screen, and where the disguise ends. A disguise is the outer layer; the protection is the encryption and the pattern behind it.
### Which icons can you choose?
Four: Noxium's own icon and three lookalikes.
The icons in Settings › App settings › Change app icon, Noxium Pro.
Name in the picker Looks like
Noxium Noxium's own icon (the default)
Numbers A calculator
Memo A notes app
Sunrise A weather app
Whichever you pick, tapping it opens Noxium's lock screen, and the vault still needs your pattern. Unlike a calculator vault app , the lookalike isn't a working calculator: it changes how Noxium looks on the Home Screen, not how it opens.
### How do you change Noxium's icon?
Open the vault, go to Settings › App settings › Change app icon , and tap an icon.
- Open your vault and tap Settings .
- Tap App settings , then Change app icon under Privacy . It shows a Pro badge on the free plan.
- Tap the icon you want. iOS shows a short message confirming that the icon changed.
- To switch back, come back and tap Noxium .
### How do you give Noxium any name and picture?
Use the Shortcuts app. Noxium adds an "Open Noxium" action that opens the lock screen and never unlocks anything.
- Open the Shortcuts app and create a new shortcut.
- Add the "Open Noxium" action.
- Add it to your Home Screen with the name and picture you like, from the shortcut's share or details options.
- Move the real Noxium icon off your Home Screen into the App Library, so only your shortcut shows.
Noxium also adds a "Close Noxium" action that locks it at once. You can put it on the Action button on iPhone models that have one.
### What else does Noxium hide on screen?
Your photos stay off the screen whenever the screen could be seen by someone else's device.
- The app switcher. Swipe up and you see a plain panel with the word "Noxium", not your photos.
- Screen recording and mirroring. While the screen is recorded, mirrored or shared, Noxium shows a notice instead of vault content.
- Lock when face down. In Settings › App settings , turn on Lock when face down to lock Noxium when you put the phone down on its face.
### What doesn't a custom icon hide?
The icon only changes the picture on your Home Screen. Everywhere iOS lists apps by name, it still says Noxium.
- The name under the icon. iOS keeps the app's name, "Noxium", under any icon. Only a Shortcuts icon can carry a different name.
- Settings, search and the App Library. Searching for "Noxium" finds it, and iOS lists it by name in Settings and in Settings › General › iPhone Storage .
- Your App Store purchases, which list Noxium by its store name.
- Someone who taps it. They see Noxium's lock screen. They still need your pattern, but they'll know it's a vault. A decoy vault gives you something to open.
- Photos still in your camera roll. Delete the originals after importing, then empty Recently Deleted .
### Is it free or Pro?
Custom icons are part of Noxium Pro. The Shortcuts actions, app switcher cover and screen-recording protection work on every plan.
The free plan includes 150 photos, 10 videos, unlimited notes, 1 decoy vault, and full iCloud backup and restore. See pricing .

No. In Noxium, every icon opens the lock screen, where you draw your pattern.

# Album patterns: lock one album with its own pattern

URL: https://getnoxium.app/features/album-patterns
Last updated: 2026-11-17

Feature
## Album patterns: lock one album with its own pattern
By Inertia Projects · Last updated 17 November 2026
Short answer
iPhone's Photos app can't lock a single album; it only locks the Hidden and Recently Deleted albums. In Noxium Pro, you can give any album its own pattern. The album stays locked inside the open vault until that pattern is drawn, and its photos are sealed with a key of their own.
Sometimes one vault isn't enough separation. You might hand your phone over with Noxium open to show holiday photos, but keep one album shut. Noxium, the photo vault we make, lets you put a second lock on a single album. This page covers how it works, how to set it up, and what it doesn't do. If you only need Apple's built-in options, see how to lock photos on iPhone with Face ID .
### How does an album pattern work?
The album gets its own encryption key, and only its pattern unlocks that key. Opening the vault isn't enough.
- A key of its own. When you set an album pattern, Noxium makes a new random key for the album and re-encrypts the album's photos, videos and notes with it.
- Sealed by the pattern. That key is sealed with a key made from the album pattern through Argon2id, the same slow function that protects your vault pattern. See on-device encryption .
- Locked inside the vault. In the album list, a locked album shows a lock, the words "Locked album" and no cover photo, because its photos stay encrypted until you draw its pattern.
- Albums inside it are covered too. An album nested inside a locked album uses the nearest locked album's key.
- It locks again with the vault. Once you draw the album pattern, the album stays open until Noxium locks. The next time you open the vault, it's locked again.
### How do you lock an album with its own pattern?
Touch and hold the album, tap Give it its own pattern , and draw a new pattern.
- Open your vault and go to Albums . To make a new album first, tap New album .
- Touch and hold the album you want to lock.
- Tap Give it its own pattern . On the free plan, this opens the Pro screen.
- Draw the album pattern across at least 6 bolts. Noxium explains: "This album stays locked inside the open vault until this pattern is drawn."
- To open it, tap the album and draw its pattern on the Album locked screen.
- To remove the pattern, open the album, then touch and hold it in the list and tap Remove album pattern .
Use a pattern you don't use for any vault, and practise it. Noxium can't reset an album pattern any more than a vault pattern.
### How is this different from a decoy vault?
An album pattern hides one album inside a vault you've opened. A decoy vault is a whole separate vault with its own pattern.
- Use an album pattern when you're happy to open Noxium in front of someone but want one album to stay shut.
- Use a decoy vault when someone asks you to open Noxium and you don't want them to see anything real.
### What doesn't an album pattern protect?
It keeps an album shut; it doesn't hide that the album exists.
- The album is visible. Anyone in the vault sees its name and the lock, and may ask you to open it. Choose a dull name, or use a decoy vault instead.
- Someone who watches you draw it. As with any pattern, cover the screen with your hand.
- A forgotten album pattern. Nobody can reset it: not us, not Apple. The vault's recovery phrase opens the vault, not a locked album inside it.
- Copies outside Noxium. Photos still in your camera roll or in Recently Deleted in Photos aren't covered.
### Is it free or Pro?
Album patterns are part of Noxium Pro. Albums, albums inside albums, encrypted notes and a 30-day Recently Deleted come with every plan.
The free plan includes 150 photos, 10 videos, unlimited notes, 1 decoy vault, and full iCloud backup and restore. See pricing .
One album, its own lock
Give any album its own pattern and its own key. It stays locked inside the open vault until you draw it.
Download on the App Store
Available on the App Store for iPhone and iPad.
### Questions people ask
Can you lock individual albums on iPhone?
Not in the Photos app. iOS locks only the Hidden and Recently Deleted albums, with Face ID or your passcode. To lock one album of your choice, you need a vault app with per-album locks.
Is a locked album encrypted separately?
Yes. In Noxium, a locked album has its own key, sealed by its pattern, so opening the vault doesn't decrypt it.
Can Face ID open a locked album?
No. Face ID can open your main vault, but a locked album always needs its own pattern.
What happens if I forget an album pattern?
The album stays locked. Nobody can reset it, and the vault's recovery phrase doesn't open it, so practise the pattern before you rely on it.

# iPhone and iPad sync: one encrypted vault on both

URL: https://getnoxium.app/features/iphone-ipad-sync
Last updated: 2026-11-17

Feature
## iPhone and iPad sync: one encrypted vault on both
By Inertia Projects · Last updated 17 November 2026
Short answer
With Noxium Pro, the same vault stays in step on your iPhone and iPad through your own private iCloud. Only encrypted data travels between them. To add a device, sign in to the same Apple Account, open Noxium and draw your pattern; every plan backs up, but only Pro applies changes made on another device.
A photo vault that lives on one phone is a vault you can't open on the bigger screen. Noxium, the photo vault we make, uses the same encrypted iCloud backup to keep an iPhone and an iPad in step. This page explains what syncs, how to set it up, and what stays on each device. For the backup itself, read encrypted iCloud backup .
### How does Noxium sync between iPhone and iPad?
Each device encrypts changes before they leave it and sends them to your private iCloud. The other device downloads them and decrypts them with the vault key from your pattern.
- Encrypted on the device. Photos, videos, notes, and their names, dates and places, are encrypted before upload. See on-device encryption .
- Stored in your iCloud. Noxium runs no servers. The encrypted data sits in your private iCloud database (CloudKit) and counts toward your iCloud storage.
- Applied on the other device. With Pro, changes from another device are merged into the vault. On the free plan, each device still backs up, but changes made elsewhere aren't applied.
- Only the vault you open. Each vault syncs on its own. A decoy vault doesn't show anything from your main vault.
### How do you set up sync on an iPad?
Install Noxium on the iPad, sign in to the same Apple Account, and restore your vault by drawing its pattern.
- On your iPhone, check that the backup is current in Settings › iCloud backup . Tap Back up now if items are waiting.
- On the iPad, sign in to the same Apple Account with iCloud turned on, and install Noxium. It needs iPadOS 17 or later.
- Open Noxium. On Restore your vault , draw the pattern you use on your iPhone, or tap Use recovery phrase .
- Choose whether to download full-size photos now or later.
- Open your other vaults later. Noxium says: "Any other vaults stay safe in iCloud. Draw their patterns later to open them."
- Pro on both devices. App Store purchases follow your Apple Account, so one Pro purchase can cover both.
If Noxium is already set up on the iPad, use Settings › iCloud backup › Restore from iCloud instead. It brings a backed-up vault onto the device next to the vaults already there.
### How do you save space on the iPad?
Keep full-size copies in iCloud and small previews on the device.
- Free up space in Settings › iCloud backup removes full-size copies from the device and keeps them in iCloud.
- Download all full-size copies brings them back, for example before you travel.
- Wi-Fi only for videos makes large videos wait for Wi-Fi.
### What doesn't sync, and what doesn't it protect?
Your vaults sync. Some settings and keys stay on each device on purpose.
- Face ID. The Face ID key is kept in each device's Keychain and never syncs to iCloud. Turn it on separately on each device, or leave it off.
- Other Apple Accounts. Sync only works between devices signed in to the same Apple Account. To share a vault with another person, use a shared vault .
- Mac, Android and the web. Noxium runs on iPhone and iPad only.
- A pattern someone has seen. Every synced device opens with the same pattern. If someone saw it, change it in Settings › Change pattern .
- iCloud storage. Backups count toward your iCloud plan. If iCloud is full, backup pauses and Noxium says roughly how much more space it needs.
### Is it free or Pro?
Encrypted iCloud backup and restore are free. iPhone and iPad sync, which keeps both devices up to date with each other, is part of Noxium Pro.
The free plan includes 150 photos, 10 videos, unlimited notes, 1 decoy vault, and full iCloud backup and restore. See pricing .
The same vault on iPhone and iPad
Encrypted on each device, synced through your own iCloud. Draw your pattern on the iPad and your vault is there.
Download on the App Store
Available on the App Store for iPhone and iPad.
### Questions people ask
Can a photo vault app sync between iPhone and iPad?
Some can. Noxium Pro syncs the same encrypted vault through your private iCloud, so both devices show the same photos, videos and notes.
Can Apple see my synced photos?
Noxium encrypts everything on the device before upload, so iCloud holds only encrypted data. Without your pattern or recovery phrase, it can't be read.
Do I need Pro on the iPad too?
Pro is tied to your Apple Account through the App Store, so a purchase made on one device can be used on the other.
What happens to sync if Pro ends?
Each device keeps backing up, and you keep full access to view and export everything already in the vault. Changes made on one device stop appearing on the other.

# Shared vaults: one encrypted vault for you and one other person

URL: https://getnoxium.app/features/shared-vaults
Last updated: 2026-11-17

Feature
## Shared vaults: one encrypted vault for you and one other person
By Inertia Projects · Last updated 17 November 2026
Short answer
A shared vault in Noxium Pro is a separate encrypted vault you share with one person through iCloud. It opens with a password of 10 or more characters that you give them in person, never with your pattern, and it never touches your other vaults.
Couples, families and friends sometimes need a private place for photos they both keep: documents, a child's medical photos, or pictures meant for just the two of you. Sending them over a chat app leaves copies everywhere. Noxium, the photo vault we make, lets you share one vault instead. This page covers how it works, how to set it up, and the risks of sharing anything private.
### How does a shared vault work?
It's a vault of its own, stored in your iCloud and shared through Apple's iCloud sharing. A password opens it, not a pattern.
- Its own key. The shared vault's key is made from the password and a salt of its own, through Argon2id. Your pattern and your other vaults play no part.
- Encrypted before upload. Like every Noxium vault, its photos, videos and notes are encrypted on the device with AES-256-GCM, so iCloud only holds encrypted data. See on-device encryption .
- Shared through iCloud. Noxium uses Apple's iCloud sharing to invite the other person. They need Noxium and an Apple Account with iCloud.
- The password is the key. An invitation alone doesn't open anything. The other person also needs the password, which you give them face to face.
- Separate from everything else. Joining your shared vault doesn't give the other person any way into your main vault, your decoy vault or your pattern.
### How do you create and share a vault?
Go to Settings › Vaults › Shared vault , set a name and password, then tap Create and invite .
- Open your main vault and tap Settings . Under Vaults , tap Shared vault . It needs Pro.
- Name the vault and type a password of at least 10 characters, twice. It can't be one that already opens another vault.
- Tap Create and invite . Apple's iCloud sharing screen opens. Choose how to send the invitation.
- Tell the other person the password in person. Don't send it in the same message as the invitation.
- The other person opens the invitation. Noxium shows "Someone shared a Noxium vault with you." They tap Enter password .
- Either of you opens it later from the lock screen, with Open a shared vault .
### When is a shared vault a good idea?
When two people you trust both need the same private photos, and both of you have an iPhone or iPad.
- Partners who keep photos meant only for each other.
- Family documents: passports, insurance cards, medical photos for a child.
- A carer or relative who needs a few documents in an emergency.
### What doesn't a shared vault protect?
Encryption protects the vault from outsiders. It can't control what the other person does once they've opened it.
- The other person's choices. Anyone who can open the vault can view, export or screenshot what's in it. Only share with someone you trust with those photos.
- A relationship that ends. Stopping sharing later doesn't remove copies someone already saved. Think about this before you add intimate photos.
- A weak or leaked password. Use a long password you haven't used anywhere else, and never send it with the invitation.
- Someone who has both. A person with the invitation link and the password can open the vault. Treat them like a key and the address together.
If photos of you have been shared without your consent, StopNCII.org can help stop them spreading on participating platforms.
### Is it free or Pro?
Creating a shared vault is part of Noxium Pro. Noxium Pro also adds unlimited items, emergency erase, iPhone and iPad sync, custom icons and album patterns. See pricing .
Share one vault, keep the rest yours
A separate encrypted vault for you and one other person, opened with a password you give them in person.
Download on the App Store
Available on the App Store for iPhone and iPad.
### Questions people ask
Is there a shared photo vault app for couples?
Yes. Noxium Pro can share one encrypted vault with one other person through iCloud. It opens with a password you give them in person, and your other vaults stay private.
Can the other person see my main vault?
No. The shared vault has its own key, made from its own password. It gives no way into your pattern or your other vaults.
Does the other person need Noxium?
Yes, on an iPhone or iPad with iCloud turned on. They open your invitation in Noxium and enter the password you gave them.
Is a shared vault safer than sending photos in a chat app?
It keeps the photos in one encrypted place instead of in chat history and backups on both phones. It can't stop the other person saving copies. See are photo vault apps safe?

# Import and export: full quality in, full quality out

URL: https://getnoxium.app/features/import-export
Last updated: 2026-11-17

Feature
## Import and export: full quality in, full quality out
By Inertia Projects · Last updated 17 November 2026
Short answer
Noxium imports from Photos, Files, its own camera and the share sheet, including HEIC, ProRAW and Live Photos. It exports to Photos or Files in full quality with the original date taken. Exported copies are no longer encrypted, so move them only when you need them out of the vault.
A vault is only useful if photos go in without losing anything and come out the same way. Some vault apps shrink photos to save space , or strip the date. Noxium, the photo vault we make, keeps the original file and its date. This page covers every way in and out, and how to move photos without leaving copies behind. If you're switching from another app, see moving a vault to a new iPhone and photo vault lost photos .
### How do you add photos to Noxium?
Tap the add button in your vault and choose From Photos , From Files or Camera , or send items from any app's share sheet.
- From Photos. HEIC, ProRAW and Live Photos come in as they are. With Settings › App settings › Offer to delete from Photos on, Noxium offers to delete the originals afterwards.
- From Files. Photos and videos saved in Files, iCloud Drive or on a USB drive.
- Camera. Photos and videos taken in Noxium's camera go straight into the vault. Nothing is saved to Photos.
- "Send to Noxium". In any app's share sheet. Items are encrypted at once, even while Noxium is locked, and move into the vault you open next.
- Notes. Write encrypted notes inside the vault.
Every item is encrypted with AES-256-GCM on the iPhone before it's saved, with its name, date and place. See on-device encryption .
### How do you move photos in without leaving copies?
Add them, check them, then delete the originals and empty Recently Deleted. The full checklist, including where stray copies hide, is in moving photos into a vault app .
- Turn on Offer to delete from Photos in Settings › App settings .
- Add the photos from Photos and wait until Noxium has finished adding them.
- Check them in the vault: counts match, videos play, Live Photos move.
- Let Noxium delete the originals, and confirm iOS's prompt.
- Empty Recently Deleted in Photos. Otherwise iOS keeps the originals there for up to 30 days.
"Send to Noxium" items go into whichever vault you open next, so open your main vault, not a decoy, after sending.
### How do you export photos in full quality?
Select the items, tap Export , and choose Save to Photos , Save to Files or Share… . To leave another vault app, see how to export photos from a vault app .
- Save to Photos keeps full quality and the date the photo was taken, so it lands in the right place in your library.
- Save to Files saves the original files to Files, iCloud Drive or an external drive.
- Share… opens the iOS share sheet for AirDrop, Mail or another app.
Noxium decrypts a temporary copy to export it and deletes that copy afterwards. If a photo's full-size copy is only in iCloud, use Settings › iCloud backup › Download all full-size copies first.
### What doesn't import and export protect?
Inside Noxium, items are encrypted. Outside, they're ordinary files again.
- Exported copies. They're no longer encrypted. Anything you save to Photos or Files, or share, is outside the vault's protection.
- Originals you forget to delete. Importing copies a photo. The original stays in Photos and Recently Deleted until you remove it.
- Copies elsewhere. iCloud Photos, a computer backup or a chat app may still hold the photo.
- Someone using your unlocked vault. If you don't want export to be possible, turn on Settings › App settings › Turn off sharing . It hides export and share, and stops "Send to Noxium".
### Is it free or Pro?
Import and export work on every plan. The free plan holds 150 photos, 10 videos and unlimited notes; Pro removes the limits.
If Pro ends, you keep full access to view, export and back up everything already in your vault, so nothing is ever held hostage. See pricing .
Your originals, kept as they were
HEIC, ProRAW and Live Photos in; full quality and the original date out. Encrypted the whole time they're inside.
Download on the App Store
Available on the App Store for iPhone and iPad.
### Questions people ask
Do photo vault apps reduce photo quality?
Some do, to save space. Noxium keeps the original file, including HEIC, ProRAW and Live Photos, and exports it in full quality.
Will exported photos keep their original date?
Yes. Save to Photos keeps the date the photo was taken, so it appears in the right place in your library.
Can I export everything if I stop using Noxium?
Yes. Exporting works on every plan, and if Pro ends you keep full access to export what's in your vault.
Does importing delete photos from my camera roll?
Only if you let it. With Offer to delete from Photos on, Noxium asks after adding; then empty Recently Deleted in Photos.

# Encrypted notes: private text next to your private photos

URL: https://getnoxium.app/features/encrypted-notes
Last updated: 2026-11-18

Feature
## Encrypted notes: private text next to your private photos
By Inertia Projects · Last updated 18 November 2026
Short answer
Noxium keeps notes inside the same encrypted vault as your photos. Each note's title and text are encrypted on the iPhone with AES-256-GCM, opened only by your pattern, and backed up encrypted to your own iCloud. Notes are unlimited on every plan, including the free one.
Passwords for the vault's own photos, a PIN for a bank card, notes from a doctor's visit, or the story behind a photo: some text needs the same protection as the pictures it belongs with. Noxium, the photo vault we make, has notes built in. This page explains how they're protected, how to use them, and how they compare with Apple Notes. For Apple's own options, see how to lock photos on iPhone , which covers locked notes.
### How are Noxium notes encrypted?
Exactly like photos. A note is an item in your vault, so it gets the same encryption, backup and lock.
- Encrypted on the iPhone. The note's text is sealed with AES-256-GCM with a key of its own. Its title and preview are encrypted too. See on-device encryption .
- Opened by your pattern. The keys are unlocked by the vault key made from your pattern through Argon2id. No pattern, no notes. See pattern lock .
- Saved as you type. Each save writes a new encrypted file, checks it, and only then removes the old one, so a crash mid-save can't leave a half-written note.
- Backed up encrypted. Notes go to your private iCloud with the rest of the vault, as encrypted data. See encrypted iCloud backup .
### How do you write a note in Noxium?
Tap the add button in your vault and choose New note .
- Open your vault , or the album you want the note in.
- Tap the add button and choose New note .
- Type a title and the text. The note saves on its own, and shows when it was last edited.
- Tap Done or go back. The note sits in your vault next to your photos and videos.
- To find it later, search the vault by the note's title.
- To delete it, use the delete button in the note. It goes to Recently Deleted for 30 days first.
A note in an album with its own pattern (Pro) stays locked until that album's pattern is drawn. A note in a decoy vault only appears in that decoy.
### How do Noxium notes compare with Apple Notes?
Apple Notes is a full notes app; Noxium notes are plain text kept next to private photos.
Noxium notes and a locked note in Apple Notes
Noxium note Apple Notes, locked note
Opens with Your vault pattern iPhone passcode or a separate Notes password, Face ID
Title hidden while locked Yes, encrypted Shown in the notes list
Formatting, checklists, drawings No, plain text Yes
Lives next to Your vault's photos and videos Your other notes
Decoy Separate notes in a decoy vault No
Use Apple Notes for rich notes you're happy to lock with your passcode. Use Noxium notes for short text that belongs with your private photos and should open only with your pattern.
### What don't encrypted notes protect?
- Copies elsewhere. Text you pasted from another app, or still have in Apple Notes or a chat, isn't covered.
- The clipboard. Copying text out of a note puts it on the iPhone's clipboard, where other apps you open can read it.
- Someone who knows your pattern. They can open your notes along with everything else.
- Search by content. Vault search matches note titles, not the text inside, so give notes titles you'll remember.
### Is it free or Pro?
Encrypted notes are unlimited on every plan. The free plan also includes 150 photos, 10 videos, 1 decoy vault, and full iCloud backup and restore. See pricing .
Notes that open only with your pattern
Write private notes next to your private photos, encrypted on your iPhone. Unlimited, on every plan.
Download on the App Store
Available on the App Store for iPhone and iPad.
### Questions people ask
What's an encrypted notes app for iPhone?
An app that encrypts your notes on the device with a key only you control. Noxium does this for notes inside its photo vault; Apple Notes can lock individual notes with your passcode or a Notes password.
Are Noxium notes free?
Yes. Notes are unlimited on the free plan and on Pro.
Is a note's title encrypted?
Yes. In Noxium, a note's title and preview are encrypted along with its text, so nothing about it is readable without your pattern.
Can I get a deleted note back?
For 30 days. Deleted notes go to Recently Deleted inside the vault first, like photos.

# SPV Secret Photo Vault review: how it compares with Noxium

URL: https://getnoxium.app/compare/spv

Compare
## SPV Secret Photo Vault review: how it compares with Noxium
By Inertia Projects · Last updated 20 November 2026
Short answer
SPV - Secret Photo Vault is a popular, highly rated PIN vault with albums, a private browser and places for passwords and contacts. Its listing names no encryption, no decoy and no backup: everything stays on the phone and is deleted with the app. It also reports data used to track you. Pick SPV for a simple all-in-one locker; pick Noxium for named encryption, a decoy and an encrypted iCloud backup.
SPV - Secret Photo Vault, by Maple Labs, has been on the App Store since January 2019 and has 70,209 US ratings at 4.6 stars, which makes it one of the most used vault apps on iPhone. Several apps share the name "Secret Photo Vault", so this review is about SPV only, not Secret Photo Vault Lock Photos or Keepsafe. Everything here comes from SPV's App Store listing, checked on 20 November 2026, compared with Noxium. We make Noxium, so weigh what we say about our own app accordingly.
### Noxium vs SPV at a glance
Source: each app's US App Store listing, checked 20 November 2026. Noxium: our published facts.
Noxium SPV
Opens with Pattern on a 5×5 plate; Face ID optional PIN

Decoy Yes, 1 free Not in listing

Last update 15 November 2026 30 August 2026 (version 7.6.1)

For 17 vault apps in one table, see the full photo vault comparison .
### What does SPV do well, and where does it fall short?
SPV is easy, popular and covers more than photos. Its gaps are encryption, backup and tracking.
#### What SPV does well
- Trusted by many people. 70,209 US ratings at 4.6 stars is one of the largest rating counts of any vault app we've checked.
- Simple to start. One PIN, then albums for your photos and videos.
- More than photos. It keeps passwords and contacts too, and has a browser that, the listing says, leaves no traces.
- No server copies. The listing says SPV doesn't keep your photos or data on any server.
- Older iPhones. It runs on iOS 15 and later, on iPhone and iPad, in English, French, German and Italian.
- A free trial. The yearly plan starts with 7 days free.
#### Where SPV falls short
- No backup. The listing says data uses the device's storage only, and deleting the app deletes your photos. A lost or broken phone takes the vault with it.
- No encryption named. The listing talks about PIN protection, not about encrypting the files.
- Tracking. Its privacy label lists Data Used to Track You.
- No decoy and no recovery in the listing. It doesn't describe a fake PIN, or what happens if you forget yours.
- Unclear pricing. All 6 in-app purchases are called "Premium", from $4.99 to $39.99, so you only see what each one is inside the app.
### How are SPV and Noxium different?
SPV is a PIN screen in front of your files, kept on one phone. Noxium encrypts every file and keeps an encrypted copy in your own iCloud.
#### Encryption
Noxium encrypts every photo, video and note on the iPhone with AES-256-GCM, with a key made from your pattern through Argon2id; names, dates and places are encrypted too. SPV's listing doesn't mention encryption. A PIN screen alone keeps out someone holding your unlocked phone, but not someone who gets at the app's files another way. See how encrypted photo vaults work .
#### Backup
SPV says it keeps everything on the phone and warns you to export before deleting the app. Noxium backs up only encrypted data to your own iCloud, free, and restores on a new iPhone when you draw your pattern; see encrypted iCloud backup .
#### Decoys and emergencies
SPV's listing doesn't describe a decoy. Noxium has a second pattern that opens a separate decoy vault , free, and Pro adds an emergency erase pattern.
#### Getting back in
SPV's listing doesn't say how to recover a forgotten PIN. Noxium can't reset your pattern for you; you write down a recovery phrase at setup, and it opens your vault on this iPhone or a new one.
#### Passwords, contacts and browsing
SPV is wider: it stores passwords and contacts and has a private browser. Noxium doesn't do any of those. It's built for photos and videos, with encrypted notes alongside, and keeps HEIC, ProRAW and Live Photos as they are. For passwords, a dedicated password manager is a better home than any photo vault.
#### Privacy
SPV's privacy label lists data used to track you, and data not linked to you. Noxium has no ads, no accounts and no analytics.
#### Price
SPV's description says Premium is a weekly, monthly or yearly subscription from $2.99, with a 7-day trial on the yearly plan; its listing shows 6 purchases, all named "Premium". Noxium's free plan includes 150 photos, 10 videos, unlimited notes and full backup; Pro is $2.99 a week, $17.99 a year or $39.99 once.
### Which should you choose?
- Pick SPV if you want a familiar, simple PIN locker for photos, passwords and contacts, need it on iOS 15 or 16, and don't need a backup.
- Pick Noxium if you want named encryption, a decoy vault, an encrypted backup that survives a lost phone, a recovery phrase, and no tracking.
### How do you switch from SPV without losing photos?
Export to the photo library, check the copies, import them into the new vault, and only then delete SPV. Never delete SPV first: its listing says that deletes your photos.
- Count what you have in each SPV album.
- Export your photos and videos to the photo library from inside SPV, as its listing describes.
- Check the copies in Photos: counts match, videos play, photos open at full size.
- Move passwords and contacts to a password manager or Contacts. Noxium doesn't store them.
- Import into Noxium with Settings › App settings › Offer to delete from Photos on, then empty Recently Deleted in Photos. See import and export .
- Check the backup in Noxium's Settings › iCloud backup .
- Only then delete SPV.
Watch out
Exported photos sit unencrypted in your Photos library until the new vault imports them. Do the move in one sitting, on a phone only you are using.
A vault that survives a lost phone
Noxium backs up an encrypted copy of your vault to your own iCloud. On a new iPhone, draw your pattern and it restores.
Download on the App Store
Available on the App Store for iPhone and iPad.

It keeps photos behind a PIN and off its servers. Its listing doesn't mention encryption or a backup, and its privacy label lists data used to track you. See are photo vault apps safe?
Does SPV back up to iCloud?
Not according to its listing. It says photos and data stay in the device's storage and are deleted if you delete the app. Export them to Photos if you want a copy.
What happens to my photos if I delete SPV?
The listing says they're deleted with the app. Export everything to your photo library first.
How much is SPV Premium?
The description says subscriptions start from $2.99, by week, month or year. On 20 November 2026 the US listing showed 6 purchases named "Premium", from $4.99 to $39.99.
What if I forget my SPV PIN?
The listing doesn't say. Don't delete the app, because that deletes the photos; contact the developer and read our guide to a forgotten vault password .

### What does PV do well, and where does it fall short?
PV has more features than almost any vault app and is updated often. Its gaps are unnamed encryption, ads, tracking and backup that costs extra.
#### What PV does well
- Actively updated. Version 7.7.11 came out on 17 November 2026; its release notes list a crash fix.
- A fake password. The listing lists "Fake password protection" among its basic features.
- Emergency Switch. Turn the phone face down and PV jumps to another app.
- A way back in. You can set a recovery email under App Setting › Set Recovery Email .
- Lots of tools. Slideshow, album covers, a trash folder, a photo editor, tags, notes and search, audio files, and Nearby Drop between phones.
- Many ways to move files. Wi-Fi transfer to a computer, plus paid backup to PV's own cloud or to Dropbox, Google Drive, Box and OneDrive.
- Cleans up after itself. It can delete photos from the public library after hiding them.
#### Where PV falls short
- Encryption isn't explained. The listing mentions "encrypted data transfer" and "data encryption" but names no cipher, key or where encryption happens.
- No free backup. The listing warns that photos are stored on the device, and deleting the app deletes them if you never backed up. Cloud Sync is for Super members, third-party cloud backup for Pro.
- Ads and tracking. "Ad Free" is a paid feature, and the privacy label includes Data Used to Track You and Data Linked to You.
- A recovery email. Anyone who gets into that email may be able to reset your vault password.
- Many plans. 7 purchases, from a $3.99 monthly Pro to a $79.99 yearly 100 GB Super Member, make the right plan hard to pick.
### How are PV and Noxium different?
Both have a decoy and a disguise. The differences are encryption, backup, tracking and recovery.
#### Encryption
Noxium encrypts every photo, video and note on the iPhone with AES-256-GCM, with a key made from your pattern through Argon2id; names, dates and places are encrypted too. PV says it uses data encryption but doesn't say how. See how encrypted photo vaults work for what to look for.
#### Backup
PV's backup is a paid extra, to its own cloud or to a third-party drive. Noxium backs up only encrypted data to your own iCloud on every plan, free, and restores on a new iPhone when you draw your pattern; see encrypted iCloud backup .
#### Decoys and emergencies
PV has a fake password and the face-down Emergency Switch. Noxium has a second pattern that opens a separate decoy vault , free, and Pro adds an emergency erase pattern and Calculator, Notes or Weather lookalike icons.
#### Getting back in
PV resets a forgotten password through a recovery email. That's convenient, and it means your email account is a second key to the vault. Noxium has no reset by anyone; you write down a recovery phrase at setup, and only that phrase or your pattern opens the vault.
#### Privacy
PV shows ads in the free version and reports data used to track you and data linked to you. Noxium has no ads, no accounts and no analytics.
#### Price
PV Pro is $3.99 a month or $17.99 a year, a permanent membership is $41.99, and cloud storage is sold separately: $12.99 a year for 20 GB of auto backup up to $79.99 a year for a 100 GB Super Member. Noxium's free plan includes 150 photos, 10 videos, unlimited notes and full backup; Pro is $2.99 a week, $17.99 a year or $39.99 once.
### Which should you choose?
- Pick PV if you want lots of tools, a fake password and face-down switch, Wi-Fi transfer, a recovery email, or backup to Dropbox, Google Drive, Box or OneDrive.
- Pick Noxium if you want named encryption, no ads or tracking, a free encrypted backup in your own iCloud, and a recovery phrase instead of an email reset.
### How do you switch from PV without losing photos?
Export to the photo library, check the copies, import them into the new vault, and only then delete PV.
- Count what you have in each album, including anything behind the fake password you want to keep.
- If you use PV's cloud, download everything back to the phone first.
- Export photos and videos to the photo library, or to a computer with Wi-Fi transfer.
- Check the copies: counts match, videos play, photos open at full size.
- Import into Noxium with Settings › App settings › Offer to delete from Photos on, then empty Recently Deleted in Photos. See import and export .
- Check the backup in Noxium's Settings › iCloud backup .
- Only then delete PV, and cancel any PV subscription in Settings › [your name] › Subscriptions .
Watch out
Exported photos sit unencrypted in your Photos library until the new vault imports them. Do the move in one sitting, on a phone only you are using.
Backup included, encrypted, in your iCloud
Noxium backs up an encrypted copy of your vault to your own iCloud on every plan. No ads, no account, no tracking.
Download on the App Store
Available on the App Store for iPhone and iPad.

It locks photos with a password, Touch ID or Face ID and says data is encrypted, but doesn't say how. Its privacy label includes data used to track you. See are photo vault apps safe?
Does PV have a fake password?
Yes. Its listing lists fake password protection. See what a decoy vault is and how to test one.
What if I forget my PV password?
The listing says to set a recovery email under App Setting › Set Recovery Email, which is used if you forget the password. Set it before you need it.
Does PV back up my photos?
Only on a paid plan. Photos are stored on the device, and the listing warns they're gone if you delete the app without a backup.

# Encamera review: how it compares with Noxium

URL: https://getnoxium.app/compare/encamera
Last updated: 2026-11-20

Compare
## Encamera review: how it compares with Noxium
By Inertia Projects · Last updated 20 November 2026
Short answer
Encamera is a private camera and photo vault that encrypts everything you add, has no account, no ads and no tracking, and has published its file and encryption code. iCloud storage and unlimited photos need Premium, and its listing describes no decoy and no recovery. Pick Encamera for open code and a private camera; pick Noxium for a decoy vault, a recovery phrase and a free encrypted iCloud backup.
Encamera, by Encamera LLC, has been on the App Store since November 2022. It's a smaller app than most vaults, with 149 US ratings at 4.5 stars, but one of the few that lets you read part of its code. Everything here comes from its App Store listing and its public EncameraCore code page, checked on 20 November 2026, compared with Noxium. We make Noxium, so weigh what we say about our own app accordingly.
### Noxium vs Encamera at a glance
Source: each app's US App Store listing and Encamera's EncameraCore page on GitHub, checked 20 November 2026. Noxium: our published facts.
Noxium Encamera
Opens with Pattern on a 5×5 plate; Face ID optional PIN or Face ID
Encryption named AES-256-GCM, key from your pattern (Argon2id) Encrypts all media; code page says it uses Swift-Sodium (libsodium)
Code you can read No File handling and encryption (EncameraCore)

For 17 vault apps in one table, see the full photo vault comparison .
### What does Encamera do well, and where does it fall short?
Encamera is one of the most privacy-minded vaults on the App Store, and the most open about its code. Its gaps are the free plan, decoys and recovery.
#### What Encamera does well
- Encrypts everything you add. The listing says all media you import or take with its camera is encrypted.
- Code you can check. Encamera has published EncameraCore, the part that handles files, chunking, keys and encryption, built on Swift-Sodium, a wrapper for the well-known libsodium library.
- No account, no ads, no tracking. You don't give it an email address, and its privacy label is Data Not Linked to You.
- A private camera. Photos and videos taken in Encamera, or from its Lock Screen widget, never reach your photo library.
- Your own iCloud, per album. You choose album by album whether files stay on the device or go to your iCloud, with no third-party servers.
- Live Photos and sharing in. Live Photos are supported, and the latest release lets you share from other apps straight into a hidden or new album.
#### Where Encamera falls short
- iCloud is Premium. The listing lists iCloud storage, unlimited photos and unlimited albums as Premium features, so the free plan is limited and has no cloud copy.
- No decoy in the listing. There's no fake PIN or second vault described.
- No recovery in the listing. It doesn't say what happens if you forget your PIN.
- Only part of the code is open. EncameraCore is the file handling and encryption; the rest of the app isn't published there.
- Confusing plans. 7 purchases, including two monthly ($2.99 and $3.99) and two yearly ($17.99 and $19.99) options, and a "Limited Lifetime" that covers new features for only one year.
### How are Encamera and Noxium different?
Both encrypt on the iPhone, have no account and keep backups in your own iCloud. The differences are what's free, decoys, recovery and open code.
#### Encryption and open code
Noxium encrypts every photo, video and note on the iPhone with AES-256-GCM, with a key made from your pattern through Argon2id; names, dates and places are encrypted too. Encamera encrypts with libsodium through Swift-Sodium, and you can read that code yourself, which Noxium doesn't offer. See how encrypted photo vaults work for what open code does and doesn't prove.
#### Backup
Both use your own iCloud. In Encamera, iCloud storage is a Premium feature you turn on per album. In Noxium, the encrypted backup is on every plan, free, and restores on a new iPhone when you draw your pattern; see encrypted iCloud backup .
#### Decoys and emergencies
Encamera's listing doesn't describe a decoy. Noxium has a second pattern that opens a separate decoy vault , free, and Pro adds an emergency erase pattern.
#### Getting back in
Encamera's listing doesn't say how to recover a forgotten PIN. Noxium has no reset by anyone; you write down a recovery phrase at setup, and it opens your vault on this iPhone or a new one.
#### Camera
Both have a camera that saves straight into the vault. Encamera adds a Lock Screen widget for quick capture.
#### Price
Encamera Premium is $1.99 a week, $2.99 or $3.99 a month, $17.99 or $19.99 a year, $49.99 for Limited Lifetime or $99.99 for Lifetime. Noxium's free plan includes 150 photos, 10 videos, unlimited notes and full backup; Pro is $2.99 a week, $17.99 a year or $39.99 once.
### Which should you choose?
- Pick Encamera if being able to read the encryption code matters most to you, you want a Lock Screen camera, and you're happy to pay for iCloud storage.
- Pick Noxium if you want a decoy vault, a recovery phrase, and an encrypted iCloud backup on the free plan.
### How do you switch from Encamera without losing photos?
Make sure every album is on the phone, export, check the copies, import them into the new vault, and only then delete anything.
- Count what you have in each album, including albums stored in iCloud.
- Download any iCloud albums to the phone, so nothing is left only in the cloud.
- Export photos and videos from Encamera to Photos or Files.
- Check the copies: counts match, videos play, Live Photos move.
- Import into Noxium with Settings › App settings › Offer to delete from Photos on, then empty Recently Deleted in Photos. See import and export .
- Check the backup in Noxium's Settings › iCloud backup .
- Only then delete the files from Encamera, and cancel Premium in Settings › [your name] › Subscriptions .
Watch out
Exported photos sit unencrypted in Photos or Files until the new vault imports them. Do the move in one sitting, on a phone only you are using.
A decoy, a recovery phrase and a free backup
Noxium encrypts on your iPhone and backs up only ciphertext to your own iCloud, on every plan. Draw a second pattern for a decoy vault.
Download on the App Store
Available on the App Store for iPhone and iPad.
### Questions people ask
Is Encamera safe?
It encrypts all media, has no account, ads or tracking, and has published its encryption code. Its listing doesn't describe a decoy or a way to recover a forgotten PIN. See are photo vault apps safe?
Is Encamera open source?
Partly. Its EncameraCore code, which handles files, keys and encryption, is published on GitHub. The listing says its code is open for review.
Does Encamera back up to iCloud?
Yes, to your own iCloud, album by album, with Premium. On the free plan, files stay on the device.
What is Encamera's Limited Lifetime?
A one-time purchase ($49.99 in the US) that keeps the app's features forever but includes new features for one year only. Lifetime ($99.99) includes all future features.
Does Encamera have a decoy vault?
Not according to its listing. If you need one, read what a decoy vault is and which apps have one.

# Obscura review: how it compares with Noxium

URL: https://getnoxium.app/compare/obscura
Last updated: 2026-11-21

Compare
## Obscura review: how it compares with Noxium
By Inertia Projects · Last updated 21 November 2026
Short answer
Obscura is one of the most careful vaults on the App Store: AES-256-GCM, open-source encryption code, no accounts, no cloud and a Data Not Collected label, plus encrypted document scanning and 10 password-separated vault slots. It has no cloud backup of its own; you back up with an encrypted export file or iOS's iCloud backup. Pick Obscura for open code and documents; pick Noxium for a pattern lock, a recovery phrase and an encrypted backup in your own iCloud.
Obscura: Encrypted Photo Vault, by Orlio Inc, came to the App Store in March 2026 and has 30 US ratings at 4.4 stars. It's young and small, but it's one of the few vaults that publishes the code that encrypts your files, along with an honest list of that code's limits. Everything here comes from its App Store listing and its ObscuraCrypto code page, checked on 21 November 2026, compared with Noxium. We make Noxium, so weigh what we say about our own app accordingly.
### Noxium vs Obscura at a glance
Source: each app's US App Store listing and Obscura's ObscuraCrypto page on GitHub, checked 21 November 2026. Noxium: our published facts.
Noxium Obscura
Opens with Pattern on a 5×5 plate; Face ID optional Password; Face ID or Touch ID
Encryption AES-256-GCM; key from your pattern through Argon2id AES-256-GCM; key from your password through PBKDF2, 600,000 rounds
Code you can read No Encryption code (ObscuraCrypto)
Backup Your own iCloud, encrypted, free Encrypted export file you keep anywhere; iOS iCloud backup
Decoy Yes, 1 free 10 hidden vault slots, each with its own password; any can be a decoy
Forgot your code Recovery phrase you write down at setup No reset, by design
What it stores Photos, videos, notes Photos, videos, scanned documents and PDFs
Free plan 150 photos, 10 videos, unlimited notes 50 photos and documents, 1 vault
Price (US) Free; Pro $2.99/week, $17.99/year or $39.99 once Free; Pro $6.99/month, $29.99/year or $39.99 lifetime
Tracking No ads, no accounts, no analytics No accounts or analytics; privacy label: Data Not Collected
Last update 15 November 2026 19 November 2026 (version 1.22.0)
Requires iOS 17 or later iOS 18.2 or later
For 17 vault apps in one table, see the full photo vault comparison .
### What does Obscura do well, and where does it fall short?
Obscura gets the hard parts right and explains them openly. Its gaps are backup, recovery and a small free plan.
#### What Obscura does well
- Named, checkable encryption. AES-256-GCM for every photo, video, document and database, and the encryption code is published on GitHub with tests you can run.
- Honest about limits. Its code page explains that PBKDF2 is weaker against graphics-card guessing than newer methods like Argon2, and says so plainly.
- Data Not Collected. No accounts, no analytics, and no internet connection needed.
- Documents done well. Scan passports, IDs and receipts, search them by their text, get expiry reminders, and share a "Safe Copy" with parts blacked out.
- Hidden vault slots. 10 slots always exist, each opening with its own password, with no list or count, so a second vault works as a decoy.
- Fair when you stop paying. If a subscription ends, you can still view and export everything. Export is free on every plan.
- Actively updated. Version 1.22.0 came out on 19 November 2026.
#### Where Obscura falls short
- No cloud backup of its own. You export an encrypted file and store it yourself, or rely on iOS's own iCloud backup of the phone.
- No way back in. There's no password reset or recovery phrase. Forget the password and the vault is gone.
- A small free plan. 50 photos and documents in one vault.
- Pricier subscriptions. $6.99 a month or $29.99 a year.
- Needs iOS 18.2. Older iPhones that can't update are left out.
### How are Obscura and Noxium different?
Both encrypt on the iPhone with AES-256-GCM, collect no data and have no account. The differences are how your code becomes a key, backup, recovery and open code.
#### Encryption and open code
Noxium stretches your pattern into a key with Argon2id, which needs a lot of memory for every guess, and encrypts names, dates and places too. Obscura uses PBKDF2 with 600,000 rounds, which meets current OWASP guidance and is built into Apple's own code. Obscura's encryption code is public; Noxium's isn't, and publishes its design on the on-device encryption page instead. See how encrypted photo vaults work for what these terms mean.
#### Backup
Obscura deliberately has no cloud: you export one encrypted .obscura file and keep it on a computer, drive or cloud service you choose. Noxium backs up only encrypted data to your own iCloud, free and automatically, and restores on a new iPhone when you draw your pattern; see encrypted iCloud backup .
#### Decoys
Obscura's 10 hidden slots each open with their own password, so any one can be a decoy. Noxium has a second pattern for a separate decoy vault , free, and Pro adds an emergency erase pattern.
#### Getting back in
Neither developer can reset your code. Obscura has no recovery at all. Noxium gives you a recovery phrase at setup, which opens your vault if you forget your pattern.
#### Documents
Obscura is far ahead for documents: scanning, text search, expiry reminders and redacted copies. Noxium keeps photos, videos and encrypted notes, and imports HEIC, ProRAW and Live Photos in full quality.
#### Price
Obscura Pro is $6.99 a month, $29.99 a year or $39.99 lifetime, with a one-week trial on the yearly plan. Noxium's free plan includes 150 photos, 10 videos, unlimited notes and full backup; Pro is $2.99 a week, $17.99 a year or $39.99 once.
### Which should you choose?
- Pick Obscura if you want to read the encryption code, you store IDs and documents as well as photos, and you're happy to manage your own encrypted backup file.
- Pick Noxium if you want a pattern lock, a recovery phrase in case you forget, an automatic encrypted backup in your own iCloud, and a bigger free plan.
### How do you switch from Obscura without losing photos?
Export a fresh encrypted backup first, export the photos, check them, import them into the new vault, and only then delete anything.
- Export an encrypted .obscura backup and keep it until you're done. It's your safety net.
- Open each vault slot you use and count what's in it, including folders with their own password.
- Export photos and videos to Photos or Files.
- Check the copies: counts match, videos play, Live Photos move.
- Import into Noxium with Settings › App settings › Offer to delete from Photos on, then empty Recently Deleted in Photos. See import and export .
- Check the backup in Noxium's Settings › iCloud backup .
- Only then delete the items from Obscura, and cancel Pro in Settings › [your name] › Subscriptions .
Watch out
Exported photos sit unencrypted in Photos or Files until the new vault imports them. Do the move in one sitting, on a phone only you are using. Noxium doesn't store documents, so keep scanned IDs in Obscura or another safe place.
Encrypted, with a way back in
Noxium encrypts on your iPhone, backs up only ciphertext to your own iCloud, and gives you a recovery phrase in case you forget your pattern.
Download on the App Store
Available on the App Store for iPhone and iPad.
### Questions people ask
Is Obscura safe?
It names AES-256-GCM, publishes its encryption code, and collects no data. Its main risk is losing access: there's no password reset, so keep the password and an export file safe. See are photo vault apps safe?
Is Obscura open source?
Its encryption code, ObscuraCrypto, is on GitHub. The app's screens, database and Face ID handling are not part of it, as its code page explains.
Does Obscura back up to iCloud?
Not to a cloud of its own. Its listing lists iOS system iCloud backup, and you can export the whole vault as one encrypted file to keep anywhere.
What if I forget my Obscura password?
The listing says there's no password reset, by design, and the developer can't open your vault. Read our guide to a forgotten vault password before you delete anything.
How much is Obscura Pro?
On the US App Store in November 2026: $6.99 a month, $29.99 a year, or $39.99 for Lifetime.

# Safe Lock review: how it compares with Noxium

URL: https://getnoxium.app/compare/safe-lock
Last updated: 2026-11-21

Compare
## Safe Lock review: how it compares with Noxium
By Inertia Projects · Last updated 21 November 2026
Short answer
Safe Lock - Hidden Photo Vault is a highly rated, private vault with many lock types, a fake password that opens a fake gallery, break-in photos, shake-to-lock and a Data Not Collected label. Its listing names no encryption and no automatic backup: files stay on the phone unless you export them to a cloud yourself. Pick Safe Lock for lock options and a fake gallery; pick Noxium for named encryption and an encrypted iCloud backup.
Safe Lock - Hidden Photo Vault, by developer Katerina Akhlebinina, has been on the App Store since March 2017 and has 24,991 US ratings at 4.8 stars, one of the highest scores of any vault app we've checked. Its listing also calls it "Safe Lock - Private Photo Vault". Everything here comes from its App Store listing, checked on 21 November 2026, compared with Noxium. We make Noxium, so weigh what we say about our own app accordingly.
### Noxium vs Safe Lock at a glance
Source: each app's US App Store listing, checked 21 November 2026. Noxium: our published facts.
Noxium Safe Lock
Opens with Pattern on a 5×5 plate; Face ID optional PIN, dot lock, numeric or letter password, Touch ID or Face ID
Encryption named AES-256-GCM, key from your pattern (Argon2id) Not in listing
Backup Your own iCloud, encrypted, free None automatic; export to Dropbox, Google Drive, Yandex.Disk, iCloud or Box, or Wi-Fi transfer
Decoy Yes, 1 free Fake password opens a fake gallery
Forgot your code Recovery phrase you write down at setup Not in listing
Intruders Content hidden in the app switcher and screen recordings Break-in reports with photos; shake or flip to lock
Price (US) Free; Pro $2.99/week, $17.99/year or $39.99 once Free; Premium $4.99, $19.99 or $29.99 (periods shown in the app)
Tracking No ads, no accounts, no analytics Privacy label: Data Not Collected
Last update 15 November 2026 17 August 2026 (version 3.1)
Requires iOS 17 or later iOS 12 or later
For 17 vault apps in one table, see the full photo vault comparison .
### What does Safe Lock do well, and where does it fall short?
Safe Lock is well loved, private by its label and full of lock features. Its gaps are encryption and backup.
#### What Safe Lock does well
- Very well rated. 4.8 stars from 24,991 US ratings.
- Data Not Collected. The listing says the developer has no access to your secrets, and photos and videos are saved only on your device.
- A fake gallery. A fake password opens a harmless gallery instead of your real one.
- Many ways to lock. PIN, dot lock, numeric or letter passwords, Touch ID and Face ID, plus shaking or flipping the phone to lock and hide the app at once.
- Break-in reports. It takes a photo of someone who tries the wrong code.
- Lots of ways to move files. Wi-Fi transfer, and import or export with Dropbox, Google Drive, Yandex.Disk, iCloud and Box.
- Extras. A hidden camera with zoom, notes, GIF and PDF support, slideshows, a custom icon and dark mode. It runs on iOS 12 and later.
#### Where Safe Lock falls short
- No encryption named. The listing describes locks and secret folders, not encrypted files.
- No automatic backup. Files stay on the phone; you have to export them to a cloud yourself to keep a copy.
- No recovery in the listing. It doesn't say what happens if you forget your code.
- Unclear plans. All 3 purchases are called "Premium Account" ($4.99, $19.99 and $29.99), so you see what each covers only in the app.
### How are Safe Lock and Noxium different?
Both keep your photos away from their developer and have a decoy. The differences are encryption, backup and recovery.
#### Encryption
Noxium encrypts every photo, video and note on the iPhone with AES-256-GCM, with a key made from your pattern through Argon2id; names, dates and places are encrypted too. Safe Lock's listing doesn't mention encryption. A lock screen keeps out someone holding your phone; encryption also protects files copied off it another way. See how encrypted photo vaults work .
#### Backup
Safe Lock leaves backup to you: export to a cloud service, where copies may no longer be locked. Noxium backs up only encrypted data to your own iCloud, free and automatically, and restores on a new iPhone when you draw your pattern; see encrypted iCloud backup .
#### Decoys and intruders
Safe Lock's fake password opens a fake gallery, and it photographs failed unlock attempts. Noxium has a second pattern for a separate decoy vault , free, and Pro adds an emergency erase pattern and Calculator, Notes or Weather lookalike icons.
#### Getting back in
Safe Lock's listing doesn't describe recovery. Noxium can't reset your pattern for you; you write down a recovery phrase at setup, and it opens your vault on this iPhone or a new one.
#### Price
Safe Lock lists three "Premium Account" purchases, at $4.99, $19.99 and $29.99. Noxium's free plan includes 150 photos, 10 videos, unlimited notes and full backup; Pro is $2.99 a week, $17.99 a year or $39.99 once.
### Which should you choose?
- Pick Safe Lock if you want many lock types, a fake gallery, break-in photos and shake-to-lock, need it on an older iPhone, and are happy to back up by exporting.
- Pick Noxium if you want named encryption, an automatic encrypted backup that survives a lost phone, and a recovery phrase.
### How do you switch from Safe Lock without losing photos?
Export the photos, check the copies, import them into the new vault, and only then delete anything.
- Count what you have in each secret folder, and in the fake gallery if you want to keep it.
- Export photos and videos to your Photo Roll, or to a computer with Wi-Fi transfer.
- Check the copies: counts match, videos play, photos open at full size.
- Import into Noxium with Settings › App settings › Offer to delete from Photos on, then empty Recently Deleted in Photos. See import and export .
- Check the backup in Noxium's Settings › iCloud backup .
- Delete any copies you exported to Dropbox, Google Drive or another cloud, if you no longer need them.
- Only then delete Safe Lock, and cancel Premium in Settings › [your name] › Subscriptions .
Watch out
Exported photos sit unencrypted in your Photos library until the new vault imports them. Do the move in one sitting, on a phone only you are using.
A vault that survives a lost phone
Noxium backs up an encrypted copy of your vault to your own iCloud, automatically. On a new iPhone, draw your pattern and it restores.
Download on the App Store
Available on the App Store for iPhone and iPad.

Yes. Its listing says a fake password opens a fake gallery. See what a decoy vault is and how to test one.

You can export or import files with iCloud, Dropbox, Google Drive, Yandex.Disk or Box, but the listing doesn't describe an automatic backup.

## MaxVault review: how it compares with Noxium
By Inertia Projects · Last updated 21 November 2026
Short answer
MaxVault is a "super app": a file vault, private browser and downloader, media player, editor and scanner, with folder locks, several vaults on different passcodes, break-in alerts and cloud sync to iCloud Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive. Its listing names no encryption, and its privacy label includes Data Linked to You. Pick MaxVault for features and file types; pick Noxium for named encryption and an encrypted backup in your own iCloud.
Photo & Video Vault - MaxVault, by Rambax, LLC, has been on the App Store since November 2013 and has 3,482 US ratings at 4.7 stars. Version 8, its biggest update, added collages and a video editor, and version 8.0.15 came out on 11 November 2026. Everything here comes from its App Store listing, checked on 21 November 2026, compared with Noxium. We make Noxium, so weigh what we say about our own app accordingly.
### Noxium vs MaxVault at a glance
