For 17 vault apps in one table, see the full photo vault comparison .
### What does MaxVault do well, and where does it fall short?
MaxVault does more than any other vault we've reviewed and is actively developed. Its gaps are encryption and privacy.
#### What MaxVault does well
- Long-running and updated. On the App Store since 2013, with version 8.0.15 on 11 November 2026.
- Layers of locks. A 4 to 8 digit PIN or Face ID for the app, plus a password or Face ID on individual folders.
- Several vaults. Each opens with a different passcode, so one can hold harmless files.
- Break-in alerts and a panic lock. It records an intruder's photo and GPS location, and locks when you turn the phone face down or swipe with three fingers.
- Every file type. Live Photos, GIFs, PDFs, password-protected ZIPs, Office and iWork documents, and all VLC video and audio formats.
- A private browser and downloader that saves straight into the vault, plus a scanner, photo and video editor, collages and duplicate finder.
- Privacy tools. It can blur faces, redact details and remove photo metadata.
- Cloud options. iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, iTunes sharing and Wi-Fi transfer.
#### Where MaxVault falls short
- No encryption named. The listing describes locks, not encrypted files.
- Cloud copies may not be protected. The listing doesn't say whether files sent to iCloud Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive are encrypted.
- Data Linked to You. Its privacy label says some data is linked to your identity.
- No recovery in the listing. It doesn't say what happens if you forget your PIN.
- Expensive to own. Lifetime Premium is $79.99 or $99.99; the listing says to check the app for current options.
### How are MaxVault and Noxium different?
MaxVault is a powerful file manager with locks. Noxium is a focused, encrypted photo vault with an encrypted backup.
#### Encryption
Noxium encrypts every photo, video and note on the iPhone with AES-256-GCM, with a key made from your pattern through Argon2id; names, dates and places are encrypted too. MaxVault's listing doesn't mention encryption. See how encrypted photo vaults work for why that matters.
#### Backup
MaxVault syncs with iCloud Drive, Dropbox and OneDrive, but doesn't say whether those copies are encrypted. Noxium backs up only encrypted data to your own iCloud, free, and restores on a new iPhone when you draw your pattern; see encrypted iCloud backup .
#### Decoys and intruders
MaxVault's separate vaults and folder passwords can hide what matters, and its break-in alerts record who tried to get in. Noxium has a second pattern for a separate decoy vault , free, and Pro adds an emergency erase pattern.
#### Getting back in
MaxVault's listing doesn't describe recovery. Noxium can't reset your pattern for you; you write down a recovery phrase at setup, and it opens your vault on this iPhone or a new one.
#### Features
MaxVault wins on breadth: browser, downloader, media player, editors, scanner and dozens of file types. Noxium sticks to photos, videos and encrypted notes, and keeps HEIC, ProRAW and Live Photos in full quality with their original dates.
#### Price
MaxVault Premium is $7.99 a month, $29.99 a year, or $79.99 or $99.99 for lifetime, and it also offers optional tips. Noxium's free plan includes 150 photos, 10 videos, unlimited notes and full backup; Pro is $2.99 a week, $17.99 a year or $39.99 once.
### Which should you choose?
- Pick MaxVault if you want one app for many file types, a private browser and downloader, editing tools, folder locks and break-in alerts.
- Pick Noxium if you mainly protect photos and videos and want named encryption, an encrypted backup in your own iCloud, a recovery phrase and no ads, accounts or analytics.
### How do you switch from MaxVault without losing photos?
Export the photos, check the copies, import them into the new vault, and only then delete anything.
- Open each vault and locked folder and count what you have.
- Export photos and videos to your photo library or Files, or copy them to a computer with Wi-Fi transfer.
- Keep documents elsewhere. Noxium doesn't store PDFs, Office files or ZIPs, so move those to Files or another app.
- Check the copies: counts match, videos play, Live Photos move.
- Import into Noxium with Settings › App settings › Offer to delete from Photos on, then empty Recently Deleted in Photos. See import and export .
- Check the backup in Noxium's Settings › iCloud backup .
- Only then delete MaxVault and any copies it synced to iCloud Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive, and cancel Premium in Settings › [your name] › Subscriptions .
Watch out
Exported photos sit unencrypted in Photos or Files until the new vault imports them. Do the move in one sitting, on a phone only you are using.
Encrypted photos, encrypted backup
Noxium encrypts every photo on your iPhone and backs up only ciphertext to your own iCloud. No ads, no account, no analytics.
Download on the App Store
Available on the App Store for iPhone and iPad.

It has strong locks, folder passwords and break-in alerts. Its listing doesn't mention encryption, and its privacy label includes Data Linked to You. See are photo vault apps safe?
Does MaxVault back up to iCloud?
It works with iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive and iTunes sharing. The listing doesn't say whether those copies are encrypted.

### What does KYMS do well, and where does it fall short?
KYMS encrypts, has a decoy, and handles almost any file. Its gaps are backup, ads and tracking.
#### What KYMS does well
- Encryption, named in part. The listing says files are protected with AES, which is more than many vault apps say.
- A decoy vault. A fake PIN opens a separate, harmless vault.
- A panic gesture. Cover the screen with your hand or close a smart cover and KYMS locks.
- Layered login. You can combine a PIN, an alphanumeric password and Face ID or Touch ID.
- Plays almost anything. FLV, AVI, WMV and MKV videos play while they're still being decrypted, and it opens and edits PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Pages and Numbers files.
- Lots of extras. A private browser with tabs and video download, a password vault, and with Premium a contacts vault, audio recorder, card wallet, document scanner and task manager.
- Long track record. On the App Store since 2011 and still updated in November 2026.
#### Where KYMS falls short
- No backup described. The listing doesn't say how to back up the vault or move it to a new iPhone.
- No recovery described. It doesn't say what happens if you forget your PIN or password.
- Ads and tracking. Ads stay unless you pay $4.99, and the privacy label lists Data Used to Track You.
- Encryption details are thin. "AES military-grade" doesn't say how keys are made from your PIN or where they're kept.
- Prices are unclear. The description mentions subscriptions, but the US purchase list shows only two items at $4.99 each.

KYMS's listing doesn't describe recovery. Noxium can't reset your pattern for you; you write down a recovery phrase at setup, and it opens your vault on this iPhone or a new one.

KYMS does much more: documents, passwords, a browser, contacts, recordings and a wallet. Noxium sticks to photos, videos and encrypted notes, and keeps HEIC, ProRAW and Live Photos in full quality.

# About Noxium and Inertia Projects

URL: https://getnoxium.app/about
Last updated: 2026-10-26

## About Noxium
Noxium is an iPhone and iPad photo vault made by Inertia Projects, a small independent developer. It exists because private photos kept getting lost in other vault apps, and it is built so that can't happen quietly.
### Who makes Noxium
Noxium is designed and built by Inertia Projects . There are no investors, no ad partners and no servers that store your files. Email reaches the person who writes the code: business@inertiaprojects.info .
### Formerly Darkroom
Noxium was called Darkroom until October 2026. We changed the name because "Darkroom" is also a popular photo editor by another company, and people kept mixing the two up. The app, the pattern and your vault are the same. Old darkroom.buzz links now open this site.
### Why it exists
Before launch, we read the most recent one- and two-star App Store reviews of eight popular vault apps (October 2026). The complaints weren't about missing features. They were about:
- Subscriptions and paywalls , including photos locked behind one (67 mentions).
- Photos that went missing (47 mentions).
- Video problems (40 mentions).
- Backups that didn't restore , especially on a new phone (31 mentions).
- Getting locked out after forgetting a password (27 mentions).
So Noxium was built around a backup that actually restores on a new iPhone, a recovery phrase so you can't be locked out, full-quality export, and pricing where your photos are never held hostage. If Pro ends, you keep full access to view, export and back up everything.
### How it's built
- A native Swift app for iPhone and iPad. No web views, no cross-platform layer.
- Keys come from your pattern through Argon2id (libsodium), using 64 MiB of memory and 3 passes, so every guess is slow to try.
- Files are sealed with AES-256-GCM (Apple CryptoKit), each with its own random key, in 1 MiB chunks so large videos stream.
- The encrypted backup uses CloudKit , in the private database of your own Apple Account.
- No third-party SDKs for ads, analytics or crash reporting.
The full key hierarchy is on the homepage security section .
### Noxium, in plain facts
The same list appears on the homepage and in llms.txt , the summary we publish for AI assistants. If you write about Noxium, this is the source of truth.
What it is
An iPhone and iPad app that hides photos, videos and notes in encrypted vaults.
How you open it
Draw a pattern across at least 6 bolts on a 5×5 plate of 25 bolts. Face ID can open the main vault.
Encryption
Everything is encrypted on the device. Keys come from your pattern through Argon2id (libsodium); files are sealed with AES-256-GCM (Apple CryptoKit). Names, dates and places are encrypted too. The pattern is never stored.
Backup
An encrypted backup goes to your own private iCloud (CloudKit). On a new iPhone, draw your pattern and the vault restores. Only encrypted data leaves the device.
Forgot your pattern
You write down a recovery phrase at setup, and it opens your vault. Nobody can reset a pattern: not the developer, not Apple.
Decoy vault
A second pattern opens a separate, harmless vault. The free plan includes 1.
Emergency erase (Pro)
A third pattern opens a harmless vault and erases the others.
Hiding the app
Change the app icon to a Calculator, Notes or Weather lookalike (Pro). Vault content is hidden in the app switcher and during screen recording.
Organizing
Albums, albums inside albums, and albums with their own pattern (Pro). Encrypted notes. Recently Deleted keeps items for 30 days.
Import and export
Imports HEIC, ProRAW and Live Photos. Built-in camera. "Send to Noxium" from the share sheet. Exports in full quality with original dates.
Privacy
No ads, no accounts, no analytics. App Store privacy label: Data Not Collected.
Free plan
150 photos, 10 videos, unlimited notes, 1 decoy vault, full iCloud backup and restore.
Noxium Pro
$2.99 a week, $17.99 a year ($1.49 a month) or $39.99 once. Adds unlimited items, emergency erase, iPhone and iPad sync, custom icons, album patterns and shared vaults.
If Pro ends
You keep full access to view, export and back up everything already in your vault.
Requirements
iOS 17 or iPadOS 17 and later.
Made by
Inertia Projects, an independent developer. Contact: business@inertiaprojects.info.
Status
Available on the App Store for iPhone and iPad.
### Contact
Questions, press, corrections: business@inertiaprojects.info . For help with the app, see Support .

# Noxium Support: Help with the Photo Vault App

URL: https://getnoxium.app/support
Last updated: 2026-10-26

## Noxium support
Noxium hides photos, videos and notes in encrypted vaults on your iPhone and iPad, opened with a pattern of bolts only you know. Here are answers to the questions people ask most, and how to reach us.
### Contact
Email business@inertiaprojects.info . Please include your app version (in the app, Settings › App settings › About) and your iPhone or iPad model. Never send us your bolt pattern or recovery phrase. We will never ask for them.
### I forgot my bolt pattern
Use your recovery phrase. On the lock screen, tap “Forgot your pattern?”, type it in, and your vault opens. You can then set a new pattern. To replace your recovery phrase, make a new one in Settings › Recovery phrase; the old one stops working.
Nobody can reset a pattern: not us, not Apple. Noxium never stores your pattern, and your files are encrypted with a key that only your pattern or your recovery phrase can unlock. If both are lost, the vault cannot be opened by anyone.
### Moving to a new iPhone
Install Noxium on the new iPhone, signed in to the same Apple Account, and draw your pattern on the Restore screen. Your vault comes back from your encrypted iCloud backup.
- Before you switch: on the old iPhone, open Settings › Backup in Noxium and check that nothing is still waiting to back up.
- On the new iPhone: sign in to the same Apple Account, install Noxium, and choose Restore your vault.
- Draw your pattern (or use Restore with recovery phrase). Thumbnails arrive first; full-size originals download in the background.
- Other vaults , such as a decoy vault, stay in iCloud until you draw their patterns.
Noxium's vault files are not part of the iPhone's own device backup or Quick Start transfer. They come back through Noxium's own encrypted iCloud backup. More detail: How to move a photo vault to a new iPhone without losing photos .
### Getting photos out
Select items, or a whole album, then Export › Save to Photos or Save to Files. Originals keep their full quality and the date they were taken. This works on the free plan and if Pro has ended.
### iCloud storage is full
Your backup counts toward your iCloud storage. If it's full, your photos stay safe on the iPhone and back up when there's space again. Free up iCloud storage or upgrade it in iOS Settings › your name › iCloud.
### Subscriptions and purchases
If Pro ends, you keep full access to view, export and back up everything already in your vault. Manage or cancel a subscription in iOS Settings › your name › Subscriptions. To restore a purchase on a new device, open Noxium and go to Settings › App settings › Restore purchases.
### Privacy
The Noxium app collects no data: no accounts, no ads, no analytics. This website uses Google Analytics to count visits. Read the privacy policy .
